name: xxx na Kanojo ga Inaka Seikatsu o Mankitsu Suru Himitsu no Houhou
original_name: ×××な彼女が田舎生活を満喫するヒミツの方法
source:
It's basically about some country "otaku club" where fans of anime and manga gather. However, since it's in the country the magazines arrive late and there's not very many tv channels to watch. This means that they generally just help out around town and talk about anime occasionally. Due to this, they get called the "Cat's hand club".

One day, a cute girl called Riko from the city transfers to their school in the country with her cross-dressing butler. She ends up joining the otaku club. Since it's so unusual for people to transfer to this school, everyone fusses over her. With summer and the town's annual festival approaching, what will happen to the club now?

[From [url=https://liemyx.wordpress.com/2012/05/29/whats-this-an-actual-post/]Liemyx's Eroge Blog[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于乡下“御宅部”的故事，那里聚集了一群动漫迷。然而，由于地处乡下，杂志送达得很晚，能看的电视频道也很少。所以他们基本上只是在镇上帮忙，偶尔聊聊动漫。正因如此，他们被称为“猫之手部”。

一天，一个名叫理子的可爱女孩从城市转学到了乡下的学校，还带着一位女装执事。她最终加入了御宅部。由于转学到这所学校的人极为罕见，大家都对她格外关注。随着夏天和镇上一年一度的祭典临近，这个社团将会迎来怎样的变化呢？

[来自[url=https://liemyx.wordpress.com/2012/05/29/whats-this-an-actual-post/]Liemyx's Eroge Blog[/url]]
